Honestly, for a swap like this, I'd want at least a couple of hours with the Minilogue XD on Friday evening — I'd need to power it up, run through the basic functions, check all the voices are working, make sure the power adapter and soft case are all good, and then do any prep so it's ready to go for Sunday's session. If pickup is at 6:00 p.m. Friday, that puts us finishing testing and prep around 8:00 or 8:30 p.m. at the earliest, which technically works before Saturday noon — but it doesn't leave much margin if anything turns up that needs troubleshooting. An earlier pickup, even by a couple of hours, would give us a lot more breathing room. That said, if 6:00 p.m. is what works for you, it's doable — just tight."}

decisions.item_received: Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer (compact 4-voice analog synth)

commitments.detail: June will have Friday evening from 6:00 p.m. pickup to test the Minilogue XD (power up, check voices, verify power adapter and soft case, prep for Sunday recording), finishing around 8:00-8:30 p.m.
Cal will deliver the Korg Minilogue XD with original power adapter, soft case, and 30-minute setup session on Friday at 6:00 p.m.
Rhea will provide her vintage drum machine to Cal in exchange for the Minilogue XD package.
